name: JS Links – SEO Link Obfuscation
author: Pierre Ribeaucourt

sections.description:
JS Links replaces <a> tags with accessible <span> elements (role=”link”, tabindex=”0″),
encoding the URL (Base64) into a data-* attribute. As a result, crawlers don’t follow
the link while users keep the same experience (clicks and keyboard navigation).

Description (FR)

JS Links remplace les balises <a> par des <span> cliquables avec role=”link” et tabindex=”0″.
L’URL est encodée (Base64) dans data-*, donc les robots ne suivent pas le lien, tandis que
l’utilisateur garde le même comportement (clic, clavier).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the js-links folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. In the editor (Gutenberg), use the JS Link button. In menus, use the field in Appearance > Menus.
sections.faq:
How is this different from rel=”nofollow”?

A nofollow is still an <a>. JS Links removes the href and encodes the URL into data-*,
so crawlers won’t follow it.

Compatibility with Yoast / Rank Math / SEOPress?

Yes.

Accessibility?

Links are keyboard-activable (Enter/Space) via role=”link” and tabindex=”0″.
Avoid obfuscating critical links like “Skip to content”.
